description: NO AUTH / PUBLIC / READ-ONLY. Lists normalized shared parameter presets that can map one logical signal across datasets. Use this only when the shared parameter code is uncertain; when a common code such as temperature_2m is already clear, call gribstream_resolve_shared_parameter directly.

dataset.description: Optional dataset code or list of dataset codes to filter supported shared parameters.

dataset_mode.description: Whether every listed dataset must support the preset or any one may support it.

name: gribstream_list_shared_parameters
title: List shared weather parameters
